Cc=1.8 pF gives GBW about 5.3 MHz and SR about 5.5 V/us. gm6 about 300 uS puts p2 near 4x GBW, and Rz=2/gm6 adds an LHP zero, giving PM above 70 deg."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),       # input pair L (area -> flicker noise, gain)
    "gmidp": (12.0, 7.0, 15.0),     # PMOS mirror + output device gm/Id
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidn": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),     # NMOS current sources gm/Id
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "itail": (10e-6, 6e-6, 16e-6),
    "i7":    (25e-6, 15e-6, 30e-6),
    "cc":    (1.8e-12, 0.8e-12, 3e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),       # Rz = rzk/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["i7"], p["cc"]

    # bias: diode-connected reference, tail and output sink mirrored (same L, gm/Id)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    vb = m8.vgs
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], it, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)

    # input pair (source near 0.25 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and output CS device (same gm/Id and L -> matched current density)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], it / 2, vds=0.75)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i7, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M8", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp drives the mirror-diode side (M3) and vinn drives the output side (M4).
    # Node x is the first-stage output and drives PMOS M6, which inverts, so vinp is non-inverting.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("Rz", "x", "xc", rz)
    n.C("Cc", "xc", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1, gm6 = m1.gm, m6.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    a0 = a1 * a2
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * cc / (2 * PI * (cout * cc + c1 * (cout + cc)))
    pm3 = 2 * m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg) if m3.cgg > 0 else 1e12
    zd = cc * (rz - 1 / gm6)
    z = 1 / (2 * PI * zd) if zd > 0 else 1e12
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pm3)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (1 / (2 * PI * rz * c1))))
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    # CMRR ~ 2*gm1*gm3*ro5 / gds-ish
    cmrr = 2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (m5.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds) + 1e-30)
    vov6 = m6.vdsat; vov7 = m7.vdsat
    swing = vdd - vov6 - vov7 - 0.1
    gamma = 2 / 3
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    nth = math.sqrt(16 * kT * gamma / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1) * 1.5)
    noise = max(nth, 0.0) * 1.0 + 0  # thermal floor; flicker dominated by W*L of M1/M3
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = 0.9 / slew + 5 * tau

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": gbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": power,
        "slew": slew,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(a0) + 12,
        "swing": swing,
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": max(noise, 500e-9),
        "vos": 0.002,
    }
```
